source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Make sure that everything in the records is correct.
3. Contact the people who sign off on these reports.
4. Request them to explain why a particular failure has been classified as a 'minor' violation.
5. Get a second or third opinion on why a particular violation may be wrongly categorised.
6. Ask them to re-check their findings through personal experience and not by simply referring to their previous documents.
7. Ask them to elaborate on the exact nature of the violations.
8. Ask them for a detailed explanation of how this failure could potentially cause loss of life or property.
9. They will answer all these questions except the last one.
10. When they can't, just call them out on it.
11. They will either start making up details to cover their backs or pull rank and threaten you with consequences.
12. They will never tell you the real story
